title: Run a private beta at Lakeside with 50 students
text:
Two weeks before the public launch, invite ~50 students the ambassador recruits. Goal: at least 10 groups formed and some feedback on the course list before everyone else joins.

*   Use the same invite-code flow as the Westbrook beta
*   Survey after week 1 (reuse the Westbrook questions)
*   Daniel to watch matching times; we only have ~50 users so it should be fine
